environment.description: Terraform provider runs on an ECS Fargate task with ephemeral storage. The CloudFront distribution is configured with Origin Access Control (OAC) v2 with signing protocol SigV4, and the S3 bucket policy contains an explicit Deny for all principals except the CloudFront service principal (cloudfront.amazonaws.com) with condition StringEquals on AWS:SourceArn matching the distribution ARN. The distribution's cache behavior requires signed URLs (TrustedKeyGroups with a single key group). Even if the temporary file is read by another process in the container, the signed URL is only valid for the specific resource path with time-bounded expiry, and the origin cannot be accessed without going through CloudFront's signed URL validation layer. The Fargate task uses awsvpc networking mode with no public IP, security group allows egress only to CloudFront and S3 VPC endpoint (gateway type, policy-restricted to the specific bucket with condition that requests must originate from CloudFront).
